evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Commercial superconducting Nb-Ti is well known, and ordered NbTi/Nb3Ti calculations are also prior. Dated exact P4/mmm Nb3Ti queries did not find an experimental superconducting exact ordered phase. The hypothesis is this source ordering and matched Nb-for-Ta construction at finite-grid scalar approximation, not new Nb-Ti chemistry or inherited bcc alloy Tc.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The exact ordered source has positive Gamma optical compression and no signed negative sampled-path value; fine full max stress is 0.142 GPa. The central competition is known disordered bcc Nb-Ti versus this ordered tetragonal/fcc-derived phase, not an assumption that the experimental alloy validates this ordering. Antisite/phase conversion, SOC and fine residual stress can change the result. Current source local stability is positive finite-grid evidence, not a bulk equilibrium certificate.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=0.096 GPa, full max stress=0.142 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Nb replaces the three Ta sites as a whole-element construction with complete ordered role mapping across all three symmetry tolerances. Volume contracts 0.5332%, Nb-Nb versus Ta-Ta falls 0.0050234 A; all ten lambda values rise 11.164–18.705% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 17.938 to 22.733 K. Retained single-site Mo/W controls have larger gains, while the Ta single edit has mixed signs; no global ranking or all-three-route conjunction is claimed.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare the source ordered tetragonal basin with a same-composition disordered/bcc competitor at matched method and a controlled ordering or distortion path. Retained positive pairing response and local stability support the source-phase screen; barrierless conversion or erased response oppose it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
